title: The zodiac and the four elements are canon; the zodiac is built two ways, and only elements by levels unfolds in sign order (2026-10-28)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
So, this concept has been recorded in  error repeatedly. And described repeatedly.

The zodiac is canon. 
The 4 elements are cannon.

The zodiac can be created in two ways.
When the modalities are used as the second axis, we just get a different order. 
When we use individual/relational/systemic as an axis with the elements we get an order that unfolds to the same as the zodiac signs in order
